Bab II Fonologi (pp. 5-13) covers only phonemes, vowels (8), diphthongs (3), consonants (19), distribution, clusters, minimal pairs, syllable patterns (V, VK, KV, KVK, KKV, KKVK) and morpheme shapes; no section or sentence on tekanan/aksen. Black note book #2 (notes in Capell's hand, mainly transcriptions of other people's work): grammatical notes on Simalur (west of Sumatra). Manuscript, 1 folio, 2 page scan (digitised 2020). PARADISEC collection AC2 (Arthur Capell papers), item AC2-OLVOC238. doi:10.4225/72/56EACB789E320. Open page scan:https://www.paradisec.org.au/fieldnotes/image_viewer.htm?OLVOC238,2(fileshttps://www.paradisec.org.au/fieldnotes/images/OLVOC238/large/OLVOC238_00001_L.JPGand..)
sources.note: The PARADISEC fieldnotes inventory (OLVOC.htm) describes AC2-OLVOC238 as 'Black note book #2. Notes in Capell's hand. Mainly transcriptions of other people's work. Notes on Simalur (West of Sumatra) - grammatical notes', date range 'probably early 1930s', 1 folio (2 page scan); the OLAC/DataCite record adds language smr, 'Language as given: Simalur (Simeulue)'. The handwriting has not been read or transcribed by anyone in this survey; whether it carries any accent/tone remark is unknown.
